title: HiPredict: Predicting the missing HiRISE RED4 spectral channel with machine learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (HiRISE) onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO) acquires imagery of Mars at 25--30 cm/pixel, supporting studies of martian geology, climate history, and landing-site characterization. Its 14-detector focal plane assembly includes several overlapping detectors that enable the acquisition of three-channel colour-infrared images, which are important for identifying compositional variations and studying active surface processes. In 2023, a detector in the center of the focal plane assembly (RED4) began failing intermittently, creating a gap in acquired imagery and reducing the instrument's colour-imaging capability by half. The HiRISE processing pipeline provides a synthetic red (SYN4) channel obtained by linearly scaling the co-located infrared (IR10) channel. translated_title: HiPredict：利用机器学习预测HiRISE缺失的RED4光谱通道
translated_abstract: 搭载于火星勘测轨道器（MRO）上的高分辨率成像科学实验（HiRISE）以25-30厘米/像素的分辨率获取火星影像，支持火星地质、气候历史和着陆点表征等研究。其14探测器焦平面组件包含多个重叠探测器，可获取三通道彩色红外图像，这对于识别成分变化和研究活跃的表面过程十分重要。2023年，焦平面组件中心的一个探测器（RED4）开始间歇性故障，在获取的影像中产生了缺失区域，使仪器的彩色成像能力降低了一半。HiRISE处理流程目前通过对共址的红外（IR10）通道进行线性缩放来提供合成红色（SYN4）通道。然而，这种方法无法捕捉颜色通道之间观察到的非线性关系，限制了其准确性和应用效果。
tldr: 本文提出HiPredict方法，利用机器学习捕捉颜色通道间的非线性关系，从而更准确地重建HiRISE仪器因RED4探测器故障而缺失的光谱通道数据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HiPredict, a machine learning approach that captures non-linear relationships between color channels to more accurately reconstruct the missing HiRISE RED4 spectral channel data lost due to detector failure.
